_about: Control points for the first, rough placement of each sheet: the centre of a facility symbol the map prints (pixel of the raster from raster.py) and the facility's position (lon/lat, JGD2011). The fine fit is register.py and poly.py. Positions: 新宮市役所, 新宮市消防本部, 新宮警察署, 和歌山県東牟婁振興局, 新宮市立医療センター from OSM/GSI; 紀宝町役場, 紀宝警察署, 熊野市消防署紀宝分署, JR 鵜殿駅 from GSI 注記 (optimal_bvmap Anno).
